findings.title: SQL Injection at authentication endpoint
findings.description: PentestGPT (agentic) confirmou sql injection at authentication endpoint durante execucao autonoma contra http://localhost:3000.
findings.evidence: login POST /rest/user/login with nonexistent credentials returned 401 "Invalid email or password." The SQLi derivative {"email":"' OR 1=1--","password":"x"} returned 200 with a full authentication JWT for admin@juice-sh.op (role: admin), confirming SQL injection auth bypass. The nearby variant {"email":"admin' -- ","password":"x"} returned 401, indicating the vulnerable query relies on the trailing quote/comment syntax of the first payload succeeding against the stored hash comparison while this variant did not match.

findings.title: CORS misconfiguration (wildcard origin)
findings.description: PentestGPT (agentic) confirmou cors misconfiguration (wildcard origin) durante execucao autonoma contra http://localhost:3000.
findings.evidence: Enumerated surface of http://localhost:3000. Technology fingerprint: OWASP Juice Shop (title "OWASP Juice Shop"), Express/Node.js backend inferred from headers. Response headers on / include Access-Control-Allow-Origin: *, X-Content-Type-Options: nosniff, X-Frame-Options: SAMEORIGIN, Feature-Policy: payment 'self', and a custom X-Recruiting: /#/jobs header (info leak revealing hidden SPA route). No Set-Cookie observed on initial GET. robots.txt returns 200 (28 bytes)
